domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll system shall verify the personal identification number entered by an employee against the stored reference value before granting access to that employee's pay slips.
The web browser must verify the PIN typed by the user against the stored value before it unlocks the saved credential vault.

The simulation software shall let a reviewing institution check the digital signature on a submitted scenario file with the group public key, confirming that the file originated from a member of the authorised research consortium without revealing which member signed it.

The air traffic control software must validate the group signature attached to each flight plan message using the group public key, so that the controller can confirm the message came from a registered airline without learning which dispatcher signed it.
The booking system shall let a customer define a dedicated passphrase that must be correctly supplied before the contact email address on the customer's profile can be modified.
The banking application must prompt the account holder for a separately configured secret credential and verify it before accepting any change to the registered email address.

The smart-home controller shall confirm the identity of a person using its configuration console by comparing typing rhythm together with pointer movement patterns against the enrolled profile of that person.

The compiler service must establish the identity of a developer submitting a build job by matching keystroke timing and cursor motion characteristics to the biometric profile registered for that developer.
The database server shall identify each client connection by validating a submitted account name and its matching secret before any query is executed.
The sales forecasting system must verify the login name and secret phrase supplied by an analyst against the registered account before the analyst can open any forecast.
The simulation software shall permit changes to stored simulation parameters only by the user who entered them and only after that user's identity has been verified.
The compiler shall reject any edit to a saved build configuration unless the edit is made by the configuration's owner following successful identity verification.
The web browser must allow bookmarks and saved form entries to be modified solely by the profile owner who has been verified in the current session.
The data warehousing system must restrict changes to the access rights on warehouse tables to the warehouse's designated data administrator.
The sales forecasting system shall allow only the data administrator role to alter which users are entitled to edit forecast datasets.
The screen capture tool shall prevent anyone other than the designated administrator from changing the rights that govern who may edit or delete stored recordings.

The booking system shall allow only the data administrator to change the rights governing modification of reservation records, and shall store a hash of each reservation record so that any alteration can be detected.
The patient-record system must restrict modification of record-editing privileges to the data administrator and must keep a hash value for every stored clinical entry to reveal unauthorised changes.
The data warehousing system shall limit updates of table-level write privileges to the data administrator and shall compute and retain a digest of each loaded dataset so tampering can be identified.
The sales forecasting system must grant a session only when the submitted credentials match a registered account and must otherwise return the user to the sign-in screen to retry.
The online banking application shall admit a customer only if the entered customer identifier and credential are confirmed as valid, and shall redisplay the sign-in form when they are not.
The screen capture tool shall let a new user register an account and shall authenticate that user on later launches by matching a scanned fingerprint to the enrolled template.
The simulation software must support enrolment of a researcher's fingerprint when an account is created and must require a matching fingerprint scan to start each session.
The electronic purse shall attach a keyed message authentication code to every transaction log entry stored on the card so that any modification of an entry can be detected when the log is read.
The booking system must compute a keyed hash-based message authentication code over each audit file and must flag a file whose code no longer matches its content.
The data warehousing system shall protect each load-job record file with a keyed HMAC tag and shall report any file whose recomputed tag differs from the stored tag.
The data warehousing system shall append a keyed message authentication code to every extraction log so that unauthorised edits to the log content are detectable.
The database server must sign its server event files with a keyed HMAC and must verify the tag whenever a file is opened to ensure the content is unchanged.
The electronic purse must calculate a message authentication code over the stored balance-change history so that tampering with the history can be recognised by the terminal.
